ionization_ratio.doc: Ionisation coefficient ratio k; lower is quieter

ignore_edges.doc: Symbols to discard at each end of the window (circular-filter wrap)

adaptive_timing.doc: Choose the sampling instant that maximises Q

sample_offset.doc: Sampling instant within the symbol when timing is fixed

passes.doc: Times the sequence is run through

linewidth.doc: Lorentzian FWHM linewidth; 0 disables phase noise

test_phases.doc: Candidate rotations searched across a quarter turn

window.doc: Symbols averaged per estimate; longer is quieter but slips sooner

insertion_loss.doc: Insertion loss applied to every input

ignore_edges.doc: Symbols to discard at each end of the window

remove_frequency_offset.doc: Estimate and remove a carrier frequency offset before measuring

extent.doc: Half-width of the window, in outermost-point magnitudes

max_output_power.doc: Output power clamp; the gain is reduced to hold it

bandwidth.doc: Optical bandwidth over which ASE is emitted

dispersion.doc: Dispersion parameter D at the band wavelength (0 disables)

nonlinearity.doc: Kerr coefficient gamma (0 disables, and is exact)

max_nonlinear_phase.doc: Largest nonlinear phase rotation allowed per split-step [rad]

pmd_sections.doc: Waveplates used to build the PMD realisation

chirp.doc: Linear chirp parameter C; sign matters against beta2

v_pi.doc: The modulator's V_pi, as the DSP believes it

drive_ratio.doc: Peak drive as a fraction of V_pi; back off to linearise

predistort.doc: Pre-invert the modulator's sine so the field is linear

pulse_shaping.doc: Root-raised-cosine shaping instead of holding each symbol flat

filter_span.doc: RRC length in symbols; longer leaves less residual ISI

v_pi.doc: Voltage for a pi phase shift in one arm

bias_i.doc: I-arm bias error away from the null; leaks carrier

bias_q.doc: Q-arm bias error away from the null; leaks carrier

quadrature_error.doc: Departure of the I/Q phase relationship from 90 degrees

insertion_loss.doc: Excess loss, on top of the intrinsic 3 dB

sample_offset.doc: Sample instant within the symbol; -1 selects the midpoint

agc.doc: Normalise the sampled symbols to unit mean power

matched_filter.doc: Apply the receiver's root-raised-cosine half of the pulse shaping

v_pi.doc: Voltage for a pi phase shift (drive to null)

v_bias.doc: DC bias added to the drive voltage

reference_bandwidth.doc: Reference bandwidth; 12.5 GHz is 0.1 nm at 1550 nm

bits_per_symbol.doc: Bits each downstream symbol carries; scales how many bits are emitted

insertion_loss.doc: Excess loss; an ideal PBC has none

differential.doc: Encode the quadrant differentially, so a quarter-turn ambiguity costs nothing
